blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: scope — Where a name can be accessed.
local — Variable with block or method-level scope.
global/class-level — Variable accessible in a wider scope, subject to access rules.
by value — Pass a copy of the value.
by reference — Pass an alias of the caller's variable.

blocks.title: Copying an integer
blocks.text: Assignment b=a copies the integer 5, not a reference to a storage location.

blocks.title: Passing by reference
blocks.text: Increase(ref a) gives parameter value an alias of a, so the caller a changes to 8.

blocks.title: Use modular methods
blocks.text: A short reusable method has a clear input effect, can be tested, and reduces repeated code.
